releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.34:
- Receipt Logo & High-Speed Thermal Printing: Inverted thermal logo with pure white paper background and 4.14% black dot density eliminates solid black blocks and prints receipts under 0.5s without thermal throttling.
- Clean Fallback Guarantee: Embedded raster logo fallback guarantees no corrupt/dark squares can ever print.
- Cash Tendered & Change Due: Printed customer receipts now explicitly display Payment: Cash, Tendered: $XX.XX, and Change Due: $XX.XX.
- One-Touch Quick Cash Tender: Tapping bill buttons ($5, $10, $20, $50, $100) immediately completes cash checkout and opens the Change Due & Print prompt dialog.
- Full Bar & Liquor Dispatch Routing: Added complete spirits/liquor keywords and categories (Remy Martin, Cognac, Brandy, Tequila, Whiskey, Vodka, Rum, etc.) so all bar drinks and liquors reach Bar KDS 100% reliably.
- Smart Round Deduplication on KDS: Kitchen and Bar KDS screens now automatically suppress duplicate parent tickets when child round cards are active, eliminating conflicting timers and duplicate tickets.
- 100% Quality Standard: Passed all pre-flight simulator checks and integrity audits with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
